[SOURCE_COMPONENT: kr-010868-279039-ko#amendment_reasons]
REASONS FOR ENACTMENT

[Enactment]

◇ Reasons for amendment and main contents

In connection with the amendment of the Government Organization Act (Act No. 21065, promulgated and brought into force on October 1, 2025), which provides, among other things, for reorganizing the Ministry of Environment into the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment to take charge of affairs relating to the environment, responses to climate change, and energy (excluding nuclear power generation exports and affairs relating to resources such as petroleum, coal, gas, and minerals), the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies has been enacted (Presidential Decree No. 35804, promulgated and brought into force on October 1, 2025) to prescribe the organization, scope of duties, authorized staffing levels, and other matters concerning the Ministry and its affiliated agencies. Accordingly, this Rule is intended to prescribe in detail matters such as the allocation of duties among the subordinate organizational units of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its affiliated agencies and their authorized staffing levels by rank.

<Provided by the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment>
